data.body:
This is a calm publishing space for people who skipped the skin-care boom, got burned by product noise, or only recently realized their skin needs attention.

Start with plain education, download the practical PDFs, join the newsletter if it helps, and consider the small offer shelf only when you feel oriented.

data.body: The point is not to make late starters feel behind. Dr. Lurie brings medical training, biophysics, and pharmaceutical research experience to help readers separate durable skin-health ideas from whatever happens to be loud this month.
